name: Local SEO Lesson - Module 13 Conducting a Local SEO Audit
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
A checklist-driven local SEO audit, run at onboarding and every 6 to 12 months.

# Audit areas
1. Tools: Screaming Frog, GSC, SEO Minion, MozBar.
2. On-page: unique titles with location, meta descriptions, one relevant H1, keyword-aligned content, thin pages, contact page with NAP.
3. GBP and citations: GBP matches the site; sample 5 to 10 major citations; list missing listings.
4. Backlinks: GSC Links report or Ahrefs; toxic links (rarely an issue for small local sites); competitor link gaps.
5. Technical: speed, mobile usability, crawl errors, `site:` index check, HTTPS, duplicates.
6. Competitor benchmarking: reviews, content, FAQs, links.
7. Report and action plan: issues ranked high, medium, low; fix quick wins immediately.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- TAG has a dedicated read-only auditor subagent for this (local-seo-auditor, see [Claude Code Agents](lib:brain-claude-code-agents)).
- Audit evidence goes into [Documentation Screenshots](lib:brain-documentation-screenshots) (audit stage) so every finding has a picture.
